incidents.name: Carrot transferFrom allowance bypass
incidents.notes: Carrot's transferFrom() skips the allowance subtraction entirely when _isExcludedFromFee[_msgSender()] is true, and _beforeTransfer() let the attacker add themselves to that mapping, so they could move any holder's CARROT.

sources.ref: onchain review: Carrot 0xcFF086EaD392CcB39C49eCda8C974ad5238452aC created 2022-09-28T16:26:31Z by 0x8958c8689d325fd9e2a1ede3d5dc1acfcfb65742, unrelated to attack sender 0xd11a93a8db5f8d3fb03b88b4b24c3ed01b8a411c; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 31,318.18 USDT left the pool to the attacker in the exploit transaction.
